title: feat: expand Floret model and media support
author: Itachi-1824
pr_body_excerpt:
- Discovers text, image, video, audio, transcription, and audio-transform models from the live catalog
- Adds generic text delegation and standard audio, transcription, voice-change, and isolation calls
- Uses registry video defaults and publicly hosts generated image/video artifacts with detected media types
- Streams tool progress through OpenAI-compatible delta.tool_calls without polluting assistant content
- Excludes embedding, realtime, and 3D models

gist.headline: Floret grew more petals
gist.blurb: Floret now follows the live model garden instead of carrying a tiny fixed bouquet. It can route words, pixels, sound, video, transcription, and audio transformations through one much busier little agent.
gist.summary: Floret now discovers supported text, image, video, audio, transcription, and audio-transform models from the live catalog, adds generic generation and media tools, publicly hosts generated image/video artifacts with detected media types, and streams tool progress as OpenAI-compatible delta.tool_calls.
gist.impact: Floret users can access the current catalog of supported media models through standard tools, receive usable public image/video URLs, and see streaming tool activity without it appearing in assistant messages.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Floret as a cozy branching garden-workbench where one agent terminal routes different kinds of creative media: a text scroll, framed image, tiny film reel, musical note, microphone transcript, and waveform being transformed. Polli should be the observant gardener, wearing a small tool belt and tending the branching connections, while a CRT monitor robot happily watches tool-progress bubbles travel along the branches; visible public image and video cards represent hosted artifacts.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art garden-workbench where the cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings wears a tiny tool belt and tends a branching Floret terminal that grows text scrolls, image cards, a film reel, music notes, a microphone transcript, and soft waveform flowers.
